environment.description: Node.js 18 Express application deployed on EC2 instance with EBS volume mounted at /var/app. Application runs as ec2-user with read/write access to the filesystem. pgBouncer running in transaction pooling mode on port 6432 proxying to RDS PostgreSQL 14. ALB forwards traffic directly to port 3000 with no additional rule processing. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ALB and ALB to EC2 on port 3000.
